reason: $29.99 for a month of magnesium is more than Toplux or Goli, and those last longer. The lab report on the page is a good sign, but I'd want to read it and compare the dose per dollar with what I already buy before paying this.
objection: I can get magnesium for much less per month. A named lab and a report help, but I haven't seen the report, and 'Made in China' makes me want to read it carefully before paying a premium.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $19 to $22 a box, or a report I can open and check that shows the dose and heavy metals results, with the batch number matching.
